description: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages calculated relative to the total number of utterances. The chart is divided into six colored segments, each representing a distinct emotion: Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (purple, 23.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Sadness (orange, 14.7%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), and Happiness (light blue, 8.1%). The segments are arranged clockwise starting from the top-left, with Frustration occupying the largest portion and Happiness the smallest. Each slice is labeled with its corresponding emotion and percentage value, clearly indicating the relative frequency of each emotional category within the dataset.
